page.overview:
Who is Nalasia Merhan?

She is very weak in the One Power, likely less than level in the One Power, and has been an Aes Sedai for years.

She disappears after Seanchan raid on the White Tower. She is on a shortlist of Aes Sedai that Egwene al'Vere receives when searching for candidates that may be Mesaana. It is likely she was captured by the Seanchan and made damane.
